$comment: invite.web / invite.appclip (Account group) — Redesign Pass 2 on Retro's /u/[username] invite page (retro.app CSS and captures, design/research/retro-package-copy-motion.md §7). Conflicts: design/MERGE_DECISIONS.md → 'Redesign — Account (RA-*)'.

invite.web.size.cardInset.element: mobile page: inset of the rounded blurred-photo card from the viewport edges
invite.web.size.cardInset.evidence: references/auto/retro/web/retro.app-u-nathan-iphone.png (Playwright iPhone 13, 1170 × 1992 = 390 CSS px at 3×): card edge x 18 / 1151, top y 18, bottom y 1973 on a white page
invite.web.size.cardInset.method: 18 px ÷ 3; the pill width calc(100% − 76px) = 302 px (measured 906 px ÷ 3) confirms a 378-px card

invite.web.radius.card.element: mobile page: corner radius of the blurred-photo card
invite.web.radius.card.evidence: references/auto/retro/web/retro.app-u-nathan-iphone.png top-left corner inset profile (x at rows 18–140: 112, 105, 101, 93, 85, 75, 59, 40, 28, 21, 18)
invite.web.radius.card.notes: Equals radius.global.cardLarge (36, the paywall plan card).

value.source: the group cover photo, object-fit cover, extended 3σ past the card so the blur has no faded edge

invite.web.layout.backdrop.element: mobile card and share image: the blurred-photo colour field behind the invite text (App Clip card too)
invite.web.layout.backdrop.evidence: references/auto/retro/web/retro.app-invite-background-bg2.jpeg (673 × 1280, the mobile card background); references/auto/retro/web/retro.app-og-userogsquare-nathan.png (600 × 600) — MERGE_DECISIONS L-6
invite.web.layout.backdrop.method: bg2.jpeg: edge-spread fits (erf + linear term) across the 22 strongest gradient maxima, 3-px pre-smooth; 6 fits with R² > 0.97: σ 47.1 / 62.8 / 68.4 / 68.8 / 69.5 / 71.1 px — the sharpest edge bounds σ from above at 7.0 % of the width, the high-contrast edges give 9.3–10.6 %. OG image: per-channel affine fit of the avatar photo scaled ×8.67 and Gaussian-blurred, best σ 50 px = 8.3 % of the width (weak fit, 1 − R² 0.59; 40 → 6.7 % and 60 → 10 % within 2 %). Value 0.08 of the width.
invite.web.layout.backdrop.notes: Retro's invite page shows a stock pre-blurred photo (bg1–bg6) and its share image a gradient from the profile photo; this app blurs the group's cover to the same strength. The recap backdrop (size.global.backdropBlur, σ 1.8 pt) is a different, much milder treatment and does not apply here.

invite.web.size.avatar.element: mobile page: inviter's avatar circle above the headline
invite.web.size.avatar.evidence: design/research/retro-package-copy-motion.md §7 (/u/[username] mobile: avatar 112 px circle); references/auto/retro/web/retro.app-5bff8a0be69f7ec7.css .page_profilePicture (border-radius 50%, object-fit cover, background #EDEDED)
invite.web.size.avatar.notes: The headless capture did not load the photo (ORB), so its vertical position is approximated (Gaps).

value.background: the group cover blurred to a colour field (invite.web.layout.backdrop: σ = 0.08 × the image width, under color.global.backdropDim) — Retro: a dark blurred gradient made from the profile photo; no cover → color.global.backgroundDeep

invite.web.layout.ogImage.element: share / link-preview image of an invite link
invite.web.layout.ogImage.evidence: references/auto/retro/web/retro.app-og-userogsquare-nathan.png (600 × 600): avatar x 258–340 (83 px) y 208–290; username ink y 309–348, x 234–366; 'retro.app' ink y 369–389, brightest (187, 197, 201); corners (0–3, 14–24, 33–45)
invite.web.layout.ogImage.method: pixel measurement of Retro's own OG image for an invite (/api/userogsquare)
invite.web.layout.ogImage.notes: Retro renders a person; this app renders the group the link joins (name, cover). The domain line is the owner's domain (config/app.json domain, BLOCKED until set).

value.image: og:image = the 600 × 600 image (invite.web.layout.ogImage) with og:image:width / og:image:height; twitter:card summary_large_image
value.appClip: <meta name="apple-itunes-app" content="app-id=<appStoreId>, app-clip-bundle-id=<bundleId>.Clip, app-clip-display=card, app-argument=<invite URL>">
